name: ApprovalEscrow
description: Approve (0), reject (1) or expire (2) an escrowed transaction, named by its full hash.

params.name: sender_privkey
params.help: the signing key: 32-byte Ed25519 seed as 64 hex; '-' or omitted = ZBC_KEY

notes: The tool reports escrowed_transaction_hash and transaction_id (int64 of the escrowed hash) next to its own transaction_hash.
